headline: Bank of Jamaica proposes capital relief to boost climate-resilient agriculture lending
summary: The Bank of Jamaica plans to introduce an initiative offering commercial banks a 50% reduction in regulatory risk weights for loans supporting climate-resilient agriculture investments.
why: Targeted regulatory capital relief alters commercial bank lending incentives, directing liquidity toward specific sectors like domestic food security.

impacts.name: Commercial Banks
impacts.why: Lower risk weights reduce capital requirements for specific agricultural loan portfolios.
